currentFocus.title: Define the SQL-first LIVE analytical contract

stageSummary.planned: sql-first-02 through sql-first-12; localhost fallback only if browser-first Stage 09 is blocked

baselineSource.result: The frozen V1 collector remains the verified browser-only baseline and reference.

sqlDirectionChange.requirement: The analytical layer must execute user-defined SQL automatically every configured X seconds, and changing analytical logic should normally require changing SQL rather than application code.
sqlDirectionChange.consequence: IndexedDB is no longer the target primary analytical query engine. The prior IndexedDB-primary evaluation plan is archived as superseded.

architecturePreference.fallback: Browser collector to localhost native DuckDB
architecturePreference.fallbackGate: Do not implement or benchmark localhost in parallel. Open the fallback track only after a required browser capability/performance/persistence/stability limitation is demonstrated.
architecturePreference.sqlite: Optional only if a concrete design or benchmark question justifies it.

verification.specImpact: Planning/design direction refined to browser-first. No runtime behavior or normative V2 specification changed in this work unit.

next.action: Complete SQL-first Stage 01, then evaluate only the browser-first DuckDB-Wasm path.
steps: Write observable acceptance scenarios for arbitrary SQL text, configurable X-second execution and 0..N results.
Define query-error and scheduler-overrun behavior without coupling it to implementation details.
Define the committed-data consistency boundary visible to SQL.
Proceed to Stage 02 browser SQL feasibility for DuckDB-Wasm and persistent browser storage.
Do not start localhost/native DuckDB unless the browser-first decision gate later records a demonstrated blocker.

history.rule: Superseded architecture/research plans stay discoverable as cold history and do not carry current progress.
